name: One shell
author: Brett
description: Molly as the one shell for every app: one menu over every app's screens, plugins, actions and settings (the Go menu and Go to anything: grouped by app and category, slim sliding sub menus, search, favorites, recent), built from each app's registry so new plugins appear by themselves; layout modes (one at a time, tabs, side by side, IDE) and named layouts; capability axf.shell@1 for native app mounts.

items.title: List every place in Molly
items.description: The one menu over every app (menu-index@1): Favorites, Recent, then each app's screens, plugins, actions, settings and dialogs by category.

items.title: List every app surface
items.description: What each app brings into Molly (shell-surface@1): its items and how it mounts.

items.title: Open anything in Molly
items.description: Opens a place by its ref <app>:<kind>:<id> (from list), optionally in a pane or a floating window: pane:console:screen:nav:build.

items.title: Search every app
items.description: Opens Go to anything with the words already typed.

items.title: Pick the layout mode
items.description: single (one at a time), tabs, split (side by side) or ide (docked panes).

commands.noReads: no data folder: favorites, recent, layouts and menu settings are per-device settings
